name: Agile Feint (Combat)
body:
You feint with skillful swordplay and agility rather than tricks and bluffs.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Acrobatics 7 ranks, 3rd-level duelist

Benefit: While wielding a light or one-handed piercing weapon, you may use your Acrobatics skill to feint in combat instead of the Bluff skill.

Normal: Normally you can only feint with the Bluff skill.
